products.name: Sweetgrass Botanicals - Slurricane - 1G - Live Rosin
products.description: Sweetgrass Botanicals presents Slurricane Live Rosin, a premium 1g concentrate that showcases the full essence of this celebrated strain. This extract is crafted using solventless extraction methods, preserving the plant's natural terpene profile and cannabinoids for an authentic, full-spectrum experience. Slurricane delivers a rich, sweet flavor profile with notes of berry, grape, and creamy tropical fruit, complemented by earthy undertones. The aroma is equally captivating, offering a pungent blend of fruity sweetness and subtle spice. Live rosin enthusiasts appreciate this product for its potent effects that promote deep relaxation, euphoria, and relief, making it ideal for unwinding after a long day or easing into restful sleep. The 1g size provides excellent value for dabbing connoisseurs who demand quality and flavor in every session. Experience the difference that solventless craftsmanship brings with Sweetgrass Botanicals Slurricane Live Rosin.

products.name: Sweetgrass Botanicals - Cereal Milk - 1G - Live Rosin
products.description: Sweetgrass Botanicals presents Cereal Milk Live Rosin, a premium 1g extract crafted using solventless extraction methods to preserve the plant's full spectrum of cannabinoids and terpenes. This artisanal concentrate delivers the strain's signature creamy, sweet flavor profile with subtle notes of vanilla and citrus, reminiscent of the milk left after a bowl of your favorite cereal. Live Rosin represents the pinnacle of cannabis extraction, utilizing fresh frozen material to capture the plant's essence at its peak. The result is a smooth, flavorful concentrate that offers potent effects and exceptional purity. Perfect for discerning consumers seeking premium quality and authentic taste, this 1g jar provides multiple sessions of rich, terpene-forward dabbing experiences. Ideal for concentrate enthusiasts who appreciate craft cannabis products made with meticulous attention to detail and quality.

products.name: Sweetgrass Botanicals - Dante's Lemons - 1G - Live Rosin
products.description: Sweetgrass Botanicals presents Dante's Lemons, a premium 1g live rosin extract that captures the essence of fresh-frozen cannabis at its finest. This solventless concentrate showcases the brand's commitment to quality and purity, delivering an authentic terpene-rich experience. Dante's Lemons bursts with bright citrus notes, featuring bold lemon and zesty flavors that dance across the palate. The live rosin extraction process preserves the plant's full cannabinoid and terpene profile, ensuring a potent and flavorful dab every time. Expect an uplifting and euphoric experience that sparks creativity while keeping you focused and energized. Perfect for connoisseurs who appreciate clean, full-spectrum extracts, this 1g jar offers exceptional value and versatility. Whether you're dabbing, adding to flower, or using in vaporizers, Dante's Lemons delivers smooth, flavorful vapor with each use. Sweetgrass Botanicals' meticulous craftsmanship shines through in every golden drop of this exceptional live rosin.

products.name: Sweetgrass Botanicals - Gary Payton x Apple Mints - 1G - Live Rosin
products.description: Sweetgrass Botanicals delivers premium quality with their Gary Payton x Apple Mints Live Rosin, a 1g concentrate that showcases the art of solventless extraction. This extract combines the legendary genetics of Gary Payton with the refreshing Apple Mints, creating a complex flavor profile that blends sweet, fruity apple notes with cool minty undertones and subtle earthy accents. Live rosin is crafted using ice water hash from fresh frozen cannabis, preserving the plant's full spectrum of cannabinoids and cannabis-derived terpenes for an authentic, potent experience. Expect a smooth, flavorful dab that delivers uplifting euphoria paired with focused relaxation. Perfect for concentrate enthusiasts seeking strain-specific terpenes and exceptional purity, this 1g of Gary Payton x Apple Mints offers connoisseur-grade quality in every session. Sweetgrass Botanicals brings craft cannabis to your collection.

products.name: Sweetgrass Botanicals - Superboof - 1G - Live Rosin
products.description: Sweetgrass Botanicals presents Superboof Live Rosin, a premium 1g extract that showcases the art of solventless cannabis craftsmanship. This live rosin is produced using fresh-frozen cannabis through ice water extraction and heat-press techniques, preserving the plant's full terpene profile and potent cannabinoids. Superboof delivers a complex flavor experience with gassy, earthy, and sweet notes that translate into smooth, flavorful dabs. The extract's rich concentrate consistency makes it ideal for experienced consumers seeking maximum potency and authentic cannabis flavor. Whether you're using a dab rig or portable vaporizer, this 1g of Superboof Live Rosin offers a clean, full-spectrum experience that captures the essence of the original flower. Perfect for connoisseurs who appreciate quality craftsmanship and robust effects.
